summary: Frontend E2E test of enhanced iLogic purple branding + new background-style + brand-symbol watermark feature. ALL feature requirements verified PASS. Login page renders purple identity with large symbol watermark + iLogic logo. After admin login, --primary CSS var = '261 73% 23%' (= #2E1065 purple), active sidebar item bg = rgb(46,16,101) (purple, NOT emerald). /admin/branding shows new Brand symbol field (branding-symbol-upload + branding-symbol-url), Page background section with 4 style buttons (branding-bg-pattern/gradient/solid/image), all testids present. Selecting 'image' reveals branding-bgimage-upload conditional field; switching away hides it. Save persists; on /dashboard the data-testid='app-background' decorative layer is rendered. With gradient style: 0 img watermarks (just radial gradients). After reset->pattern (default): 2 img watermarks visible (subtle, opacity ~6-9%). Reset restores defaults (purple primary + pattern style + title 'iLogic World Cup Predictor'). Regression: /admin, /admin/users, /admin/tournament, /admin/predictions, /dashboard, /matches all load without DOM errors and app-background present on all.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx AppBackground: 'gradient' and 'pattern' share the same radial-gradient block; the only visual difference is the two watermarks for pattern. For 'solid' style, AppBackground renders an empty div - background relies solely on body bg color from CSS vars; consider rendering a single solid color overlay for explicitness so the in-app page background follows branding.colors.background even when CSS var injection has not yet propagated.

Layout.jsx AppBackground default style fallback is 'gradient' (line 116) but DEFAULTS in Branding.jsx and seed.py are 'pattern'. If branding fetch fails, users will see gradient instead of the intended branded pattern - consider aligning default to 'pattern'.

Branding.jsx reset() flow: still shows toast 'saved' (silent=true suppresses inner toast - good) followed by 'resetDone' - acceptable single toast now, but reset() also sets local state synchronously before awaiting save; if save fails the UI lies (shows DEFAULTS while server still has old values). Wrap reset in try/catch and revert on failure.

Layout.jsx symbol watermark images do not have loading='lazy' and use opacity ~0.06; on slow networks the large PNG (the iLogic 'ايقونه' file) blocks first paint slightly - add loading='lazy' or use a smaller webp.

Branding.jsx BG_STYLES array - no i18n fallback if t('admin.branding.bg_solid') key missing in locale file; verify all four bg_pattern/bg_gradient/bg_solid/bg_image translation keys exist in both en and ar.
